text:
Trishna Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary in the South Tripura district of the Indian state of Tripura.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Belonia is a town in southern Tripura, northeastern India, close to the international border with Bangladesh. It is the administrative headquarters of South Tripura district and an important road and rail centre for reaching Trishna Wildlife Sanctuary, the archaeological remains at Pilak and the smaller towns and border landscapes of southern Tripura.
Belonia itself is a modest district town rather than a conventional tourist resort. Its principal value to travellers is as a practical base with shops, markets, banks, government services, local transport and accommodation before heading into the surrounding countryside.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
